nameEn: Manufacture of tanks, reservoirs and containers of metal
description: This class includes the manufacture of tanks, reservoirs and containers of metal for storage or manufacturing use.
includes: manufacture of reservoirs, tanks and similar containers of iron, steel or aluminium for storage and manufacturing (capacity exceeding 300 litres)
manufacture of metal containers for compressed or liquefied gas
manufacture of ship or barge sections
manufacture of aquatic structures: floating docks, pontoons, coffer-dams, landing stages, buoys
excludes: manufacture of metal cans and containers for packing, see 2599
manufacture of central heating boilers, see 2521
